detail.notInstalled: Hapana kopi yakaiswa yawanikwa, uye zvirinani: decoy haidi kuve nayo.
detail.noteDone: Unogona kuimisa izvozvi, zvinangwa zve-quest zvinofanira kunge zvakaverengwa.
detail.noteRunning: Process iri kushanda kuseri. Unogona kuderedza hwindo richienda kune tray.

detail.noExe.text: Haugone kuonekwa ne-process. Dzvanya “Gadziridza database” gare gare: kana Discord yaisa exe, mutambo unovhurika.

running.empty.title: Hapana chirikushanda
settings.title: Zvirongwa
settings.language.desc: Mutauro we-interface. Mitauro mitsva inoiswa semafaira mufolda ye-locales.
settings.defaultTime.desc: Maminitsi mangani ekuchengeta muitiro. Yakasarudzwa i16, kwete 15: ma-quest eDiscord anokumbira maminitsi 15 ekutamba, asi Discord inoda kusvika kuminiti kuti ione mutambo mutsva, saka 15 chaiyo haikwani.
settings.smartTimer.desc: Kuverenga nguva kunotanga kana Discord yaona decoy, kwete paunoitanga. Kuti izive izvozvo, purogiramu inoverenga mitsara chete pamusoro pemutambo uri kumhanya kubva mu-log yeDiscord yepakombiyuta yako; hapana chinochengetwa kana kutumirwa kumwe.
settings.autoUpdate.desc: Tarisa GitHub pakutanga uye maawa 6 ega ega wotora shanduro itsva kumashure. Kuisa kunomirira mvumo yako nguva dzose, uye mafaira anotsigirwa nesiginecha yadzo yedhijitari.
detail.waitingNote: Discord inoda kusvika kuminiti kuti ione mutambo. Kuverenga nguva kunotanga kana yaona decoy.
detail.assumed: Discord haina kusimbisa, asi nguva inoverengwa zvakadaro.
settings.autoStop.desc: Decoy inozvimisa yega kana nguva yapera.
settings.tray.desc: Ma-decoy anoramba achimhanya kana app iri mutray.
settings.showNoExe.desc: Mitambo isingazivikanwe process yayo neDiscord parizvino (haikwanise kutanga).
settings.dataDir.portable: Mhando inotakurika: zvese zvinochengetwa pedyo ne-decoy.exe.
settings.legal: Decoy haishandise token yako yeDiscord uye haigamuchire ma-quest panzvimbo pako. Kutevedzera process yemutambo kunogona kupesana nemitemo yeDiscord, shandisa uchiziva ngozi dzacho.
toast.launched: “{name}” yatanga kwemaminitsi {n}. Discord inofanira kuiona mukati memasekonzi anenge 15.
toast.timeUp: Nguva yapera, quest inofanira kunge yaverengwa
lab.title: Lab
lab.subtitle: Tebhu yakavanzika: inotanga ma-decoy akawanda kamwe chete.
lab.count.desc: Mitambo inosarudzwa zvisina urongwa, iyo iri kutoshanda inodarika. Mumwe nemumwe unomhanya kwemaminitsi {n} (zvakatarwa muZvirongwa).
lab.warn: Decoy yega yega inzira yakazvimirira ine hwindo rayo. Dzawandisa panguva imwe zvinogona kumisa komputa yako kushanda: nzira nehwindo rega rega zvinoshandisa ndangariro (memory), uye mushure mezviuru zvehwindo Windows inogona kurega kugadzira mamwe. Ukavhara Decoy, decoy dzese dzinomira.
lab.limit: Windows yamira kutanga nzira itsva mushure me-{n}: ndiwo muganhu we-system.
notify.title: Nguva yapera
